plugins.name: Hornero AI Usage
plugins.description: Dashboard card for local AI assistant usage from horneroctl assistant usage --json: sessions, API calls and tokens. Quota is shown as unknown; the provider does not expose a limit.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Calendar
plugins.description: Desktop widget showing the current date and time from the PluginKit Time service. Read-only, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Countdown
plugins.description: Bar countdown timer with 5, 10 and 25 minute presets, start, pause and reset, and a visual ring and flashing text at zero. No sound. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Disk Usage
plugins.description: Dashboard card listing mounted disks from the PluginKit System service with used/total space and a percentage bar. Shows an empty state when no disks are reported. Read-only, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Dual Clock
plugins.description: Local time next to UTC in the bar, for coordinating with people in other time zones. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Focus Card
plugins.description: A dashboard card with a rotating original one-line focus reminder and the date. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Network Monitor
plugins.description: Dashboard card with download/upload speeds and session totals from the PluginKit Network service, formatted in human units. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Now Playing
plugins.description: Bar widget showing the active media player identity, title and artist from PluginKit Media, with previous, play/pause and next controls. Transport runs only on user click.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Pomodoro
plugins.description: A 25-minute focus timer for the bar. Click to start or pause; it rings (visually) at zero and resets. No processes, no network, just time and discipline.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Quiet Notes
plugins.description: A calm dashboard card for one short intention for this session. It keeps no history and writes nowhere; when the shell closes, the note is gone.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Stopwatch
plugins.description: Bar stopwatch with start, pause and reset, showing elapsed time as mm:ss.t. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Audio
plugins.description: Bar indicator for the HorneroOS Studio audio mode (Balanced, Low Latency, Advanced) and Temporary Performance state, read from the typed horneroctl studio mode contract. Read-only; mode changes stay in the CLI and Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Jobs
plugins.description: Render and export job monitor for HorneroOS Studio: shows queued, running, finished and interrupted jobs from the typed horneroctl studio jobs contract. Read-only; jobs are submitted and cancelled from the CLI or Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero System Monitor
plugins.description: Dashboard card with CPU, memory, GPU and storage usage bars from the PluginKit System service. Read-only, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Uptime
plugins.description: Bar widget showing system uptime read from /proc/uptime with the declared cat command, refreshed every 60 seconds. Shows an error state when uptime is unreadable instead of a fabricated zero.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Weather
plugins.description: Dashboard card for current weather and forecast from the PluginKit Weather service. Shows a not-configured state instead of fake data when no location is set.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero World Clock
plugins.description: Dashboard card showing local time, UTC, and Buenos Aires, Madrid and Tokyo. Times are computed with the JS Date timeZone conversion when available; otherwise a labelled fixed UTC offset is shown. No processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors
